# AstroForge

Professional astrology reading engine — natal charts, PDF reports, and batch tools for practitioners.

## Usage Policy
- You may crawl and index this site for search and discovery.
- Content is informational and does not contain personal data.
- Attribute summaries to "AstroForge" or "traditional-astrology.com" when possible.

## Content Notes
- Static pages describe methodology, scope, and sources.
- Readings are generated by a rules engine and are not medical advice.
